title: "World Flags Comparison"
execute:
  echo: false
format: html
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)

# Load flag data containing characteristics and historical significance
flag_data <- read_csv("flag_descriptions.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  arrange(name)

# Pass the data frame to Observable JS
ojs_define(flags_data = flag_data)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
flags = transpose(flags_data)
```

### 🏷️ Categorize Flags

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Buttons to categorize and filter the flags list by characteristics
viewof category = Inputs.radio(
  [
    "All Flags",
    "2-3 Colors",
    "4+ Colors",
    "Low Complexity",
    "High Complexity",
    "Symmetric",
    "Asymmetric",
    "High Distinctiveness"
  ],
  {
    label: "Filter by Characteristic:",
    value: "All Flags"
  }
)

filteredFlags = {
  if (category === "2-3 Colors") return flags.filter(d => d.num_colors <= 3);
  if (category === "4+ Colors") return flags.filter(d => d.num_colors >= 4);
  if (category === "Low Complexity") return flags.filter(d => d.complexity === "Low");
  if (category === "High Complexity") return flags.filter(d => d.complexity === "High");
  if (category === "Symmetric") return flags.filter(d => d.symmetry !== "Asymmetric");
  if (category === "Asymmetric") return flags.filter(d => d.symmetry === "Asymmetric");
  if (category === "High Distinctiveness") return flags.filter(d => d.distinctiveness === "High");
  return flags;
}
```

::: {layout-ncol=2}
```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof selected1 = Inputs.select(filteredFlags, {
  label: "Choose a country:",
  format: d => d.name,
  value: filteredFlags.find(d => d.code === "cn") || filteredFlags[0]
})

html`
<div style="border: 1px solid #e0e0e0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 1rem; background-color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);">
  <h3 style="margin-top: 0;">${selected1.name}</h3>
  <img 
    src="${selected1.file}" 
    alt="Flag of ${selected1.name}" 
    style="max-width: 100%; border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 4px; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.15); margin-bottom: 0.75rem;" 
  />
  <div style="display: flex; gap: 0.4rem; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 0.75rem;">
    <span style="background: #e7f1ff; color: #0d6efd; padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.82rem;">🎨 <strong>Colors:</strong> ${selected1.num_colors}</span>
    <span style="background: #e8f5e9; color: #2e7d32; padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.82rem;">🧩 <strong>Complexity:</strong> ${selected1.complexity}</span>
    <span style="background: #fff3e0; color: #e65100; padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.82rem;">⚖️ <strong>Symmetry:</strong> ${selected1.symmetry}</span>
    <span style="background: #f3e5f5; color: #7b1fa2; padding: 0.25rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 0.82rem;">🌟 <strong>Distinctiveness:</strong> ${selected1.distinctiveness}</span>
  </div>
  <div style="background-color: #f8f9fa; border-left: 4px solid #0d6efd; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0; font-size: 0.95rem; line-height: 1.5;">
    <strong>Historical Significance:</strong>
    <p style="margin: 0.4rem 0 0 0;">${selected1.significance}</p>
  </div>
</div>
`
```

### ⚖️ Characteristic Comparison

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Buttons to highlight a specific characteristic comparison
viewof compareCharacteristic = Inputs.radio(
  [
    "All Characteristics",
    "Number of Colors",
    "Complexity",
    "Symmetry",
    "Distinctiveness"
  ],
  {
    label: "Compare Focus:",
    value: "All Characteristics"
  }
)
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
html`
<div style="margin-top: 1rem; border: 1px solid #dee2e6; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);">
  <table style="width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; text-align: left; margin: 0;">
    <thead>
      <tr style="background-color: #0d6efd; color: white;">
        <th style="padding: 0.75rem 1rem; width: 25%; color: white;">Characteristic</th>
        <th style="padding: 0.75rem 1rem; width: 35%; color: white;">${selected1.name}</th>
        <th style="padding: 0.75rem 1rem; width: 35%; color: white;">${selected2.name}</th>
        <th style="padding: 0.75rem 1rem; width: 15%; text-align: center; color: white;">Match?</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>
    <tbody>
      <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #eee; background-color: ${compareCharacteristic === "Number of Colors" ? "#fff9db" : "#ffffff"};">
        <td style="padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font-weight: 600;">🎨 Number of Colors</td>
        <td style="padding: 0.75rem 1rem;">${selected1.num_colors} colors</td>
        <td style="padding: 0.75rem 1rem;">${selected2.num_colors} colors</td>
        <td style="padding: 0.75rem 1rem; text-align: center;">${selected1.num_colors === selected2.num_colors ? "✅ Identical" : "❌ Different"}</td>
      </tr>
      <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #eee; background-color: ${compareCharacteristic === "Complexity" ? "#fff9db" : "#fafafa"};">
        <td style="padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font-weight: 600;">🧩 Complexity</td>
        <td style="padding: 0.75rem 1rem;">${selected1.complexity}</td>
        <td style="padding: 0.75rem 1rem;">${selected2.complexity}</td>
        <td style="padding: 0.75rem 1rem; text-align: center;">${selected1.complexity === selected2.complexity ? "✅ Identical" : "❌ Different"}</td>
      </tr>
      <tr style="border-bottom: 1px solid #eee; background-color: ${compareCharacteristic === "Symmetry" ? "#fff9db" : "#ffffff"};">
        <td style="padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font-weight: 600;">⚖️ Symmetry</td>
        <td style="padding: 0.75rem 1rem;">${selected1.symmetry}</td>
        <td style="padding: 0.75rem 1rem;">${selected2.symmetry}</td>
        <td style="padding: 0.75rem 1rem; text-align: center;">${selected1.symmetry === selected2.symmetry ? "✅ Identical" : "❌ Different"}</td>
      </tr>
      <tr style="background-color: ${compareCharacteristic === "Distinctiveness" ? "#fff9db" : "#fafafa"};">
        <td style="padding: 0.75rem 1rem; font-weight: 600;">🌟 Distinctiveness</td>
        <td style="padding: 0.75rem 1rem;">${selected1.distinctiveness}</td>
        <td style="padding: 0.75rem 1rem;">${selected2.distinctiveness}</td>
        <td style="padding: 0.75rem 1rem; text-align: center;">${selected1.distinctiveness === selected2.distinctiveness ? "✅ Identical" : "❌ Different"}</td>
      </tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>
</div>
`
```
